text_block_list.text:
During lunch break.
I spotted Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black
having a serious discussion.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a tea party was a bit too formal,
you think? Maybe something more casual would've been better?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see. But what kind of casual get-together
would make the groundskeepers happy, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Groundskeepers? You mean from the other day?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, after that day, we tried inviting
the staff who take care of us to a tea party,
but—

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you tea party? Ah, I appreciate the thought,
but you really don't need to go out of your way for me!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Maintaining the track is my job, after all.
Seeing you girls run your hearts out without worry is more than enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Dorm Matron
text_block_list.text:
Instead of fussing over us, eat plenty,
sleep well, and stay healthy! That's all we ask!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And so, our invitation was politely turned down...
choice_data_list: So that's why you're brainstorming an alternative.
So that's why you're looking for another idea.

text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness!
Satono-san, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh, McQueen-san sent this to me...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She said it's a thank-you gift for the refreshments!
She's heading out on an away match, so she asked me
to deliver it for her!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She was super happy about your cheering!
McQueen-san was totally fired up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really? What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm happy... but still...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... I am thrilled, but at the same time,
I feel a little apologetic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I only cheered because I wanted to,
so receiving a return gift feels like too much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There was really no need for such consideration—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wait...?

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you tea party? Ah, I appreciate the thought,
but you really don't need to go out of your way for me!

text_block_list.name: Dorm Mother
text_block_list.text:
Instead of worrying about us, just eat well,
sleep well, and stay healthy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... that the staff members
feel the exact same way...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...That's right, isn't it.
Support isn't something given in search of a reward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"May your dreams come true"—
It's a pure "wish" of care for someone else.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If so, what we can give back to that "wish"
isn't words, nor is it material things.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we are to answer the staff members' "wishes",
what we must do is surely—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Answer the staff members' "wishes"...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you please let me in on
the details of that too, desu_ne!?
choice_data_list: Let me lend a hand too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case, everyone,
please lend me your ears!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then I'll take care of preparing
the materials and spreading the word♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we'd love for everyone
to lend us a hand, desu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I see. If that's what it's about, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's settled, we've got to make it
an event everyone can enjoy to the fullest!
Well then, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls Who Listened
text_block_list.text:
Um! Is there anything we can
do to help out too!?

And so, Satono Diamond's plan
was set into motion—!
